body:
`IGameScreen::agent_controls()`, name tables for the 11 CControls screens and overlays, dialog rects as coarse widgets; commands `widgets`, `widget_click`, click `consumed_by`, probe `front`. About 14 files, ~500 lines (derived); Mode 2 if justified.

**Done when:** an agent lists and clicks named widgets on every CControls screen; reviewed.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.
